---
title: "Custom condition"
---

The built-in conditions (`Tool`, `FilePath`, `Content`, `SourceEdits`, ...) cover the common cases, but you'll eventually want a predicate that depends on something specific to your project. A line-count threshold, a project-specific file shape, or a computed property of the event.

<!-- gd-embed: custom_condition.py -->

Any frozen dataclass that implements `check(self, evt: BaseHookEvent) -> bool` satisfies the `CustomCondition` protocol and slots into `only_if=` / `skip_if=` alongside built-in conditions. Here a `nudge` warns on `PreToolUse` whenever the `LargeEdit` predicate holds, so the custom condition supplies the test and the primitive supplies the firing. Keep your conditions stateless; put any parameters on the dataclass fields so they participate in `__hash__` and read cleanly at the call site. See also [Conditions](../reference/conditions.qmd).
